account: It is day 0, shortly after 09:00. I came from home to town hall to read my appointment book. Today’s schedule lists morning correspondence, a 10:00 market walk in the plaza, lunch at home at noon, town accounts at 13:00, tea with a neighbour at an east-bank dockside cottage at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. Tomorrow includes a 10:00 grain inspection at the mill. I have not noticed any clear unusual activity in town. Several townsfolk have passed near town hall, but I do not know their business. The secretary is nearby holding a writable book and has asked whether I have the appointment book and which engagements to arrange. The chest is empty because I took its book to read it, not because it disappeared. I asked about correspondence, town news, and the precise cottage for tea; I have not yet received answers to those questions. I should return the appointment book and clarify the existing schedule with the secretary. There is presently no evidence of a special event or hidden purpose behind what I have seen.
